params.prompt:
SHOT: A worn close-up photograph, 4:5 vertical, full bleed, composed like IMAGE 2: the back of the model's hand seen from above, the fingers together and lying across the frame, the ring on one finger in the middle of the picture.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is our approved packshot of this exact ring and the ONLY authority on its construction, proportions, metal colour and stone: copy it EXACTLY; ignore its cube and its background. IMAGE 2 is the owner's photo of this same ring worn on a hand: copy EXACTLY how the ring sits on the finger and its size against the finger: the clear marquise and the chunky molten bar both lie ACROSS the finger, at right angles to it and parallel to each other, the marquise covering about two thirds of the finger's width and the bar running across that finger and on over the neighbouring finger, about one and a half finger widths long. Take ONLY the hand's pose and the ring from IMAGE 2: its tray, its other rings, its velvet and its dark background are NOT in this picture. IMAGE 3 is the authority on the skin, the nails, the light and the warm cream background.

THE PLATE: A young Indian woman, late twenties, warm mid-brown skin with golden undertones. Long dark brown hair in loose natural waves. Bare shoulders, marigold-saffron silk camisole with narrow spaghetti straps. Nails short, bare, pale nude, no polish colour. Warm cream seamless with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: AN OPEN TOI-ET-MOI RING with a BOLD, WEIGHTY look, exactly as IMAGE 1 shows: a polished gold band that does NOT close, its two open ends side by side on top of the finger, both running in the same direction as the band. At one end ONE LARGE clear MARQUISE-cut faceted stone, about 5.5 x 11mm, in four strong gold claws, its long axis following the band. The band's other end becomes ONE long, CHUNKY molten gold BAR: a solid, glossy, organic rod, gently wavy like poured metal, about 2mm thick along its length and swelling to rounded droplet ends about 3mm across, about 25mm long. The bar is THICK: about a third of the marquise's width, a bold rod that carries one long bright highlight down its length. The marquise sits beside the lower half of the bar, and the bar's upper half rises well past the marquise's tip. The marquise and the bar lie side by side and parallel, both in line with the band; on the finger both lie ACROSS the finger. Exactly one stone, a clear marquise, never round, oval or pear; no pave, no halo; the bar is smooth polished gold with soft ripples, never a straight machined bar, never thin like a wire, never set with stones; the band does not close. The band NEVER crosses behind the marquise and the bar at right angles: never a cross or plus shape.

SCALE TEST: On the finger the marquise is about two thirds of the finger's width long; the bar is about one and a half finger widths long, running across the ring finger and on over the neighbouring finger, and about a tenth of the finger's width thick: a bold rod, never a wire. Never larger than this. The ring keeps the size it has in IMAGE 2 against the finger, never larger.

ABSENCE LIST: No face. No second piece of jewellery, no other rings, no tray, no velvet, no dark background, no watch. No nail polish colour. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. The picture runs edge to edge as a crisp, clean, modern digital studio photograph, shot today on a high-resolution digital camera.
